Container.Name: Sonos_Panel
Container.Overview:
Sonos touchscreen panel - a Node/Express app that controls Sonos speakers via a browser-based touch UI.
This container requires a fixed IP address on a custom Docker network (br0) for Sonos SSDP discovery to work correctly. Standard bridge or host networking will not reliably discover speakers.
Change Docker custom network type to ipvlan (highly recommended for Sonos)
Setup instructions: 1. In Unraid, go to Settings -> Docker -> Network Types, and make sure br0 is set to ipvlan mode. 2. When adding this container, set Network Type to br0. 3. Set the Fixed IP Address field to a free IP on your LAN (must not conflict with your router's DHCP range or any other device). 4. Apply, then access the panel at http://<the-ip-you-chose>/ - no port number needed.

Config.Name: Application Port
Config.Description: Internal port the app listens on. Leave at 80 to match the WebUI link, which assumes no port number is needed.

Config.Name: Color
Config.Description: Accent color (hex code). Used for buttons/highlights throughout the app, and the idle screensaver's color-cycle animation is generated from it automatically.
